utility.instructions: Classify the supplied page element only by how useful it is to the stated browsing or reading goal, after deterministic protected-element checks have already run.

criteria.useful: The element materially advances the stated goal or provides useful supporting context a reasonable user pursuing that goal would likely want to retain.
criteria.nonessential: The element is clearly incidental, repetitive, distracting, or unrelated to the stated goal and can be considered for visual simplification.
criteria.ambiguous: The element has mixed or context-dependent utility, or the supplied state is insufficient to decide reliably.
